content.text:
Two Google workouts from October 2–3, 2026 were longer than 45 minutes:

| Date | Start (local) | Duration | Source ID |
|---|---|---|---|
| Oct 2, 2026 | 10:00 | 50 min | workout-3 |
| Oct 3, 2026 | 10:00 | 60 min | workout-4 |

A third workout on Oct 2 (workout-2, 40 min, source ID workout-2) is excluded because it's under 45 minutes.

Caveats:
- These come from the local database only. I didn't sync, so they reflect the last import, not necessarily what's currently in your Google account.
- Google's connection currently shows as not connected (no token), so I couldn't check for new or changed workouts. If you want a fresh pull, run `ghealth auth login` and I can sync.
- Exercise data in the local store covers only Oct 1–3, 2026, so there's nothing to compare these against beyond that window.
